verdict.rationale: Square's official MCP server (remote and local) lets an agent run arbitrary Square API calls in one session through a service catalog that includes catalog and checkout, and the Catalog API is documented for building catalog objects. That makes agent-driven product and price provisioning plausible, but the pack never documents payment-link creation or a product→price→link flow. missing for 10: explicit payment-link API documentation, documented product/price (item variation) creation flow, a hands-on or independent demonstration of the end-to-end agent session.
